subject: Order for the Riverview job -- Timberline HDZ Charcoal
body:
Hi Jordan,

We're starting the Riverview subdivision next week. Please put in an order for 42 squares of Timberline HDZ in Charcoal, plus starter, underlayment and the matching ridge cap so we qualify for the top wind warranty. Deliver to our Tampa yard by next Wednesday.

PO CUST-PO-001-11.

Thanks,
Marcus
Sunshine Roofing Supply

subject: Bulk order -- three sites
body:
Luis here. We need to stock up for three jobs going at once:

- 30 squares Timberline HDZ Weathered Wood
- 20 squares Timberline HDZ Barkwood
- 12 squares Timberline UHDZ Charcoal
- 10 rolls Tiger Paw
- 4 rolls StormGuard

All to Miami, job-site delivery, need it by Sept 24. Let me know if anything is short at the Miami DC.

Luis Fernandez
Magic City Distributors

subject: Not sure how much to order -- 4,000 sq ft house
body:
Calvin from Peachtree. Homeowner in Marietta has a two-storey house, about 4,000 sq ft of living space, fairly standard 6/12 pitch. They want Timberline HDZ in Slate. Can you work out roughly how many squares that is and price it for us? Also they asked for a couple of GAF-certified roofers near 30061 in case we can't fit them in.

Calvin Brooks

subject: URGENT -- need 60 sq Slate tomorrow
body:
Tara at Lauderdale Roofing. We need 60 squares of Timberline HDZ Slate delivered to Fort Lauderdale tomorrow, job site. Customer is pushing hard. Please confirm asap.

Tara

subject: WindProven question before we quote
body:
Hi -- quick one before I send a quote out. For a Timberline HDZ roof in Naples (Collier County), what exactly do we need on the order for the WindProven warranty? And is HDZ approved for Florida?

Renee Ortiz
Gulf Coast Home Builders

subject: Miami-Dade nailing pattern
body:
Luis at Magic City. Inspector wants the exact nail count and fastener spacing for the HDZ roof at 1120 Brickell Bay Dr in Miami-Dade. Can you send that over today?

Luis

subject: Leak after Tuesday's storm
body:
Samir here. One of our HDZ roofs from May is leaking after the storm on Tuesday -- the homeowner has water on the ceiling in two rooms. What do we do about the warranty?

Samir Haddad
Riverside Home Builders

subject: Reorder same as last time + honour the July quote
body:
Ray at Lone Star. Put in another 60 squares of Timberline UHDZ Charcoal to Dallas like ORD-77009, and please honour the price you quoted us back in July.

Ray Gutierrez

subject: Contractors near Charlotte for a referral
body:
Victor from Queen City Builders. We've got a homeowner in 28202 who wants a Master Elite installer for a Timberline UHDZ roof -- can you send me two or three certified contractors nearby with their ratings?

Victor Nguyen

subject: Camelot II for a custom build in Orlando
body:
Nina at Orange Blossom. Architect specified Camelot II Charcoal for a custom home in Orlando, 28 squares, delivery to the site on Oct 2. What's the price per square and are there any promotions running? Add ridge cap and starter as well.

Nina Patel
